# Page Inventory

**Generated:** 2026-08-14 (regenerated from the live tree; the previous 2026-04-10 version
described a pre-v0.6 architecture that no longer exists)
**Format:** reStructuredText (`.rst`) — Sphinx + shibuya + sphinx-design. **Not Markdown.**
**Scope:** every hand-written page. `docs/src/reference/api/` is generated by sphinx-autoapi
at build time, is not checked in, and must never be hand-edited.

| File | Title |
|---|---|

## Explanation — `docs/src/explanation/`

| File | Title |
|---|---|
| `index.rst` | Explanation |
| `semantic-views.rst` | What is a semantic view? |
| `type-fidelity.rst` | Warehouse types and what lands in your row |
| `duckdb-vs-warehouse.rst` | Developing on DuckDB, deploying elsewhere |

No step-by-step instructions; these link out to tutorials and how-tos for actions.

`duckdb-vs-warehouse.rst` is the hub for backend-divergence questions: result column names,
`Decimal` metrics, and driver exception classes. Four how-to pages link into it. When adding
a claim there, mark clearly whether it is measured and on which backend -- the page's own
subject is the cost of assuming DuckDB's behaviour generalises.

## Landing page

`docs/src/index.rst` — "Semolina". Grids + cards, section tabs.

## Cross-cutting anchors worth knowing

- `_howto-result-column-names:` in `typed-results.rst` — the single authority on result
  column keys being warehouse-native (`COUNTRY`, `AGG("REVENUE")`), not model field names.
  Pages that show attribute or dict access on a `Row` link here.
- `_howto-inspect-sql:` in `queries.rst` — canonical `.to_sql()` explanation.
  `warehouse-testing.rst` links to it rather than repeating it.

## Build invariants

- `nitpicky = True` in `conf.py`: every cross-reference must resolve or the build fails.
  Write API refs against the **defining module** path (`semolina.models.SemanticView`), not
  the re-export path (`semolina.SemanticView`) — autoapi only indexes the former.
- `just docs-build` treats warnings as errors.
- Line length 100.

## Coverage gaps (see `gap-report.md`)

The `semolina.engines` namespace has no narrative coverage — `DialectABC`, the three
`*Dialect` classes, and the three concrete `*Engine` classes are reachable only through the
autoapi reference. Docs route readers through `create_engine()` instead.
